name: Climb stairs for five minutes
short_description: Climb stairs for five minutes once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can climb stairs for five minutes in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Climb stairs for five minutes means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Climb stairs for five minutes in a fresh real-life scenario.
